note: The only place a model is named. A role names a need. Override one role for a call or a rollback with OPENROUTER_MODEL_<ROLE>, for example OPENROUTER_MODEL_FAST.

auto.description: No model named. Jev picks the model and reasoning effort for each request.

fast.description: Quick everyday calls. Extraction, classification, short answers, JSON, images.

sonar.why: Sonar names are products, not versions, so there is no latest alias to follow.

sonar-pro.why: Sonar names are products, not versions, so there is no latest alias to follow.

embed.why: A vector index is only valid for the model that built it, so a change means rebuilding the index.

decision.description: Closed-choice decisions on the decisions endpoint.
decision.why: This alias is used on the decisions endpoint and is not listed in the public catalogs. It follows new Jev versions.

router.note: Whether the auto role (Jev router) honors --json and --image. Measured in references/auto-routing.md; when false, those calls go to the fast role.
